clock_alignment: Kernel Origin/provider seconds fields and typed pre/post clock cells remain authoritative per Grammar. Native cell bank introduces no clock provider/unit or timestamp calibration.
effective_contract: Contract16aae7f0 plus the exact numeric tables below. These close existing named states/flags, not new capabilities or a native qualification claim.
identity_alignment: Exact executing-kernel KernelState/Origin/Registry/RawCallStore/RawCallRef/RawCallView/KernelContinuation/StateView names; backend fixed before earliest reservation, no replacement/migration after bootstrap.
peer_prerequisite: Root/Grammar/Native finite review before source authority. No actual native binding or NativeInputLease issuance can occur from this data.

typed_defaults.axis_defaults: kind/width/epoch set before dispatch, payload_bits0/stage0/commit0. Payload0 by itself is not observed. No count/error/definition default is inferred.
typed_defaults.generation_and_axis_epoch: exactu32>=1, same call generation; no in-session reuse
typed_defaults.other_widths: COUNT32/DWORD32 width4; DEFINEDNESS width1 and committed payload0or1. No other definedness payload is valid.
typed_defaults.ownership: Native-entered/prepared/commit flags are not serialized authorities; exact source-issued bank/ref/profile/target/actor bindings remain mandatory. Unknown flag bits refuse.
typed_defaults.query_commit: Means actual immutable frame capture is complete and its associated Registry frame reference exists, not that the API succeeded or its buffer semantics are defined. API result still controls QUERY_DEFINED. Zero-initialized buffers never imply capture or definedness.
typed_defaults.scalar_widths: HANDLE64 width8; BOOL32_BITS/DWORD32 width4 with unused highword0; BOOL signed interpretation occurs after commit without changing bits.
typed_defaults.unused_metadata: requested0 iff REQUESTED_PRESENT false; input_handle_bits0 iff INPUT_HANDLE_PRESENT false; absent buffer_id0xffffffff/generation0/capacity0; all pad/reserved bytes0.
